descriptionChirho: The Hebrew feminine noun for 'prophetess' (נְבִיאָה), the feminine counterpart of navi. S115629 captures the articled form ('the prophetess') while S115630 is the indefinite ('a prophetess'). This is purely a definiteness variation, not a semantic distinction. Multilingual evidence: eng 'the-prophetess/a-prophetess', spa 'la-profetisa/profetisa', hin 'नबिया', arb 'النَّبِيَّةِ/نَبِيَّةٌ', kor '여선지자/선지자', swa 'nabii-mke/nabii'.
